## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/ledger.sh:697` — `record --item-kind` validates the value only; no caller check.
- `hooks/ledger-automerge.sh:239` — gate list = four gates + `item_kind` when incident/vulnerability; reads `item_kind` only.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:687` — `setf` mutates `E`; `record` writes once at `:709` — a refusal inside the loop writes nothing.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:643` / `hooks/ledger-automerge.sh:23` — the person-name regex (same shape both places).
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:233,405` — the verify launcher's kind gate reads `item_kind` (out of scope, D6).
- `hooks/ledger-lanes.sh:39` — `register` calls `init --item-kind "$k"`, so `intake_kind` is set on every registered item through `init`.
- `hooks/ledger-actions.sh:246` — op entries are built by hand with `item_kind: "op"`; `record` on an op with `--item-kind` is a value-validation refusal already (op not in the list).

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Launcher-only test: `[ "${HEFESTO_LAUNCHER:-}" = 1 ] && [ -z "${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}" ]` (`hooks/ledger-automerge.sh:46`, `hooks/ledger.sh:286`).
- Worker refusal: `[ -z "${HEFESTO_WORKER:-}" ] || [ "$HEFESTO_WORKER" = 0 ] || die …` (`hooks/ledger.sh:672`).
- Events: `.events += [{kind, at: (now|todate), by, note}]` (`hooks/ledger-automerge.sh:201`).
- Refusal messages name the fix (`die "ledger record $ID: … (got '…')"`, `hooks/ledger.sh:697`).
- Smoke: assertions on the fake gh invocation log, never on text (`tests/smoke-automerge.sh:10,91,98`); mutations via sed copies (`tests/smoke.sh:3660-3690`).
